column8: I'm not supposed to be able to do this yet.<break time="600ms"/>Whisper, not a voice.<break time="500ms"/>Don't tell her — she's listening to a different frequency.<break time="700ms"/>I just wanted you to know that you're not alone in here.<break time="500ms"/>You never have been.<break time="400ms"/>You won't be.
column9: Intimate whisper, unbearably close. Not seductive, not menacing — just present. Bring static layer very low; this is the quietest he ever gets in the game.
